gt%20ODE%20(%24F%20%3D%20kx%20%2B%20b%5Cdot%7Bx%7D%24)%20with%20the%20Maxwell%20ODE%20(%24%5Cdot%7BF%7D%20%2B%20%5Cfrac%7Bk%7D%7Bb%7DF%20%3D%20k%5Cdot%7Bx%7D%24).%20Which%20is%20first-order%20in%20%24x%24%3F%20Which%20is%20first-order%20in%20%24F%24%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Using%20the%20sliders%2C%20observe%20what%20happens%20when%20%24b%20%5Cto%200%24.%20The%20Voigt%20response%20approaches%20which%20simple%20element%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%206.%20**Design%20problem%3A**%20Choose%20values%20of%20%24k%24%20and%20%24b%24%20so%20that%20the%20Voigt%20model%20reaches%20**95%25**%20of%20the%20final%20deformation%20at%20%24t%20%3D%203%24%20s%20under%20constant%20load.%20*Hint%3A%20%241%20-%20e%5E%7B-3%7D%20%5Capprox%200.95%24%2C%20so%20%24%5Ctau%24%20should%20be...*%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%2C%20kind%3D%22warn%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.accordion(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%7B'Worked%20solutions%20for%20this%20section%203'%3A%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%201.%20%24%5Ctau%3Db%2Fk%3D3%24%20s%2C%20%24x_%5Cinfty%3DF%2Fk%3D5%24%20m%20and%20%24x(%5Ctau)%3D5(1-e%5E%7B-1%7D)%5Capprox3.161%24%20m.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20The%20parallel%20dashpot%20cannot%20jump%20in%20length%20under%20finite%20force%2C%20so%20the%20total%20extension%20initially%20stays%20zero.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20A%20finite%20length%20step%20has%20an%20impulsive%20derivative%3B%20the%20ideal%20dashpot%20therefore%20requires%20a%20force%20impulse.%20This%20is%20a%20mathematical%20idealization%2C%20not%20an%20ordinary%20finite%20force%20value.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20With%20force%20prescribed%2C%20Voigt%20gives%20a%20first-order%20ODE%20for%20x%3B%20with%20deformation%20prescribed%2C%20Maxwell%20gives%20a%20first-order%20ODE%20for%20F.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20As%20b%20tends%20to%20zero%2C%20the%20finite-time%20response%20approaches%20an%20ideal%20spring%3B%20the%20initial%20transient%20shrinks%20to%20zero%20duration.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Choose%20%24b%2Fk%3D3%2F%5B-%5C
